name: units-atlas
title: Units Atlas: every unit-bearing readout across the E. coli simulation
question:
What quantities does the E. coli whole-cell simulation expose on its
listener and process ports, in what physical units, and over what magnitude
ranges? This is a DESCRIPTIVE reference, not a hypothesis test — a navigable
catalog of every unit-bearing readout, grouped by physical dimension (mass,
time, concentration, rate, count, volume, length), built directly from the
declared `quantity[...]` / `float[unit]` port types via live schema
resolution (`v2ecoli.library.units_resolver.build_units_index`). It pairs
with the units-propagation feature that auto-labels plot axes from these same
declared units.

executive.what_is_this:
A single descriptive study that walks the composite's declared port schemas,
groups every unit-bearing readout by physical dimension, and renders a
reference table (readout → unit, with example magnitude + range when a run
is sampled). It surfaces what is measured and in what units, and flags any
readout that is dimensionless or missing a unit.
executive.verdict_detail:
The atlas is generated from the live typed schema (no sim run required) and
rendered to a grouped HTML table. It is a reference artifact, not a gated
result — there are no pass/fail acceptance criteria.
